story_zh: 你好！我叫小明。她叫小红。我们很高兴认识你。对不起，我没听清楚你的名字。请再说一次，好吗？谢谢！不客气。我们会说中文，但是说得不太好。没关系，我们可以一起学习。再见！
story_pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Xiǎo Míng. Tā jiào Xiǎo Hóng. Wǒmen hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ. Duìbuqǐ, wǒ méi tīng qīngchu nǐ de míngzi. Qǐng zài shuō yīcì, hǎo ma? Xièxie! Bù kèqì. Wǒmen huì shuō Zhōngwén, dànshì shuō de bù tài hǎo. Méi guānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ yīqǐ xuéxí. Zàijiàn!
story_en: Hello! I'm called Xiao Ming. She's called Xiao Hong. We're very happy to meet you. Sorry, I didn't hear your name clearly. Please say it again, okay? Thank you! You're welcome. We can speak Chinese, but we don't speak very well. It doesn't matter, we can study together. Goodbye!
